scientific_integrity: All-size statements have written combinatorial proofs; an independently implemented finite enumeration supports but does not prove the universal claims.
scientific_limitations: Finite equivalence relations in a single binary relation; no other named structure.
No assertion about simultaneous equivalence relations, arbitrary finite relational structures, or larger-host extensions.
The all-equal-class special case is established prior to this work; novelty is asserted only for the nonuniform sharp first-defect enumeration and its coupled profiles.
Historical priority is best-knowledge and not independently certified.
title: Sharp extension-defect threshold and rank profiles for finite equivalence relations
